lessonsLeft.choice: listen to your body and stay active.
lessonsLeft.ledTo: physical activity keeps the mind and body strong for years to come.
lessonsLeft.rule: pay attention to early signs of illness or discomfort, don't ignore them. keep moving and staying active even when it's tough.

lessonsLeft.choice: keep up with close friends over work extra shifts.
lessonsLeft.ledTo: close circle for support and companionship.
lessonsLeft.rule: keep one close friend through every busy decade. they can be a rock in times of need.

lessonsLeft.ledTo: gave back to the community and found meaning.
lessonsLeft.rule: find ways to help others when you can. it enriches your life as much as theirs.
